external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A grocery loyalty programme member who uses the mobile app and connects partner apps.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members collect points when they shop and spend them on gift cards.

external_entities.name: member phone
external_entities.description: A member's phone that runs or stores the mobile app's refresh token.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone.

external_entities.name: partner app
external_entities.description: A web application run by another company on its own server, such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application used by members to sign in, call the rewards API, and disconnect partner apps.
processes.notes: Nobody wrote down whether the app sends a PKCE challenge.

processes.name: authorization server
processes.description: The server that authenticates members, handles authorization code flows, issues tokens and keeps authorization state.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

processes.name: rewards API
processes.description: The API called by the mobile app and used to read and write the points ledger.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger
processes.notes: It is served on the same public hostname as the support console.

processes.name: browser
processes.description: The member's browser used to sign in, approve consent, and return the authorization code to a partner app.
processes.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.

processes.name: support console
processes.description: A web application that closes a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.
processes.notes: It is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

data_stores.name: identity database
data_stores.description: The database containing member identity data and authorization state.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: points ledger
data_stores.description: The ledger containing every member's balance and every points transaction.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: The store receiving every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: use mobile app
data_flows.description: A member uses the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members use our mobile app.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: The mobile app signs the member in through the authorization server using the authorization code flow.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: The mobile app calls the rewards API with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back

data_flows.name: request tokens
data_flows.description: A partner app sends token requests containing its client secret to the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: A member signs in through the authorization server's sign-in page in a browser.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

data_flows.name: submit consent
data_flows.description: The browser submits the member's sign-in and consent to the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: approves a consent screen that lists the scopes

data_flows.name: return code
data_flows.description: The browser returns an authorization code to the partner app's redirect URI.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.

data_flows.name: store identity state
data_flows.description: The authorization server stores member accounts, credentials, authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database, together with the authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents it issues.
data_flows.data_description: member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents

data_flows.name: disconnect app
data_flows.description: The mobile app requests that a partner app be disconnected.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members can disconnect a partner app from the settings screen of the mobile app

data_flows.name: delete token
data_flows.description: The authorization server deletes the disconnected partner app's refresh token from the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which deletes that app's refresh token from the identity database

data_flows.name: download key
data_flows.description: The rewards API downloads the authorization server's public key when it starts.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API checks the signature with a public key it downloads when it starts.

data_flows.name: update ledger
data_flows.description: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

data_flows.name: write logs
data_flows.description: The rewards API writes every received request, including headers, to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: obtain token
data_flows.description: The support console takes access tokens from the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It takes access tokens from the same authorization server

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.description: The support console marks a member's account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.

trust_boundaries.name: cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's own cloud account where the system components described as running in the account operate.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: member phone
trust_boundaries.description: The member-controlled phone environment, outside the organisation's cloud account.

trust_boundaries.name: partner server
trust_boundaries.description: Servers operated by other companies for their partner applications.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: partner apps that other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The identity database contains confidential data because it stores member personal information, passwords, tokens and consents.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the store contains member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger contains confidential data because it stores member balances and points transactions.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the ledger holds every member's balance and every points transaction.

assumptions.assumption: The API log store contains confidential data because request headers may contain credentials and requests may contain member-related data.
assumptions.basis: The source states that every request, headers included, is written to the API log store.

assumptions.assumption: The rewards API is internet-facing because it is served on a public hostname.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The support console is internet-facing because it is served on a public hostname.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.
